name: 布鲁斯
evolution: 布鲁斯 → 雪顶布鲁斯 Lv.26 → 冰钻布鲁斯 Lv.42
description: 头部开始晶体化，触感冰凉，能缓慢吸收周围热量，使自身温度维持在较低水平。头顶的白色绒球对温度变化很敏锐，能帮助它判断环境冷热。
descriptionEn: Its head begins to crystallize, feeling cool to the touch; it slowly absorbs surrounding heat to keep its own temperature low. The white tuft on its head is very sensitive to temperature changes, helping it judge hot and cold in the environment.

skills.name: 冰爪
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 霜降
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 4 stacks of Freeze.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage taken by 70%; responds to attacks.

skills.name: 丢冰块
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得速度-30。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains Speed -30.

skills.name: 冰捆缚
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: 2-hit combo; each hit makes the enemy's all-skill energy cost +1.

skills.name: 暴风雪
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得1层冻结。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains 1 stack of Freeze.

skills.name: 速冻
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 2 stacks of Slow mark.

skills.name: 冰晶坠
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains all-skill energy cost +1.

skills.name: 瞬间零度
skills.description: 本回合敌方使用的技能能耗+3，应对防御：改为全技能能耗+3。
skills.descriptionEn: The skill the enemy uses this turn costs +3 energy; if responding to Defense, all-skill energy cost +3 instead.

skills.name: 滚雪球
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得2层冻结，应对状态：额外获得2层，本次技能威力翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains 2 stacks of Freeze; if responding to a status, gains 2 extra stacks and this skill's power is doubled.

skills.name: 冰雹
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：额外使敌方获得全技能能耗+3。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if responding to a status, additionally makes the enemy gain all-skill energy cost +3.
